goal: Prove all-integer exact midpoint-grid cosine alias sum, and consume it with canonical C7 in an actual summable weighted inverse-grid alias series.
source_anchor: arXiv2610.20492v1 A3.SS3.p3/Ex139; deterministic weighted consumer A3.SS3.p6/Ex144
theorem_delta:
theorem actual_midpoint_grid_cosine_alias {d : ℕ} (hd : 2 ≤ d) (k : ℤ) :
  let θ : Fin d → ℝ := fun i => ((i.val : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * Real.pi / (d : ℝ)
  (∑ i : Fin d, Real.cos ((k : ℝ) * θ i)) =
    (d : ℝ) * (if (2 * (d : ℤ)) ∣ k then
      (-1 : ℝ) ^ (k / (2 * (d : ℤ))) else 0)
